caption: The drawing features a single pistol prominently displayed in the center of a plain, light tan or off-white background. The pistol has a long, cylindrical barrel colored in dark gray, with some metallic sheen. The handle is ergonomic and covered in a textured brown material with visible grain, bordered by a gold or brass edging that outlines its contours. There is a trigger mechanism located underneath the barrel and connecting to the handle. The composition is simple, with the pistol being the sole object depicted and oriented diagonally across the page from the lower right to the upper left. A faint shadow and light shading suggest depth, while the background remains unembellished, focusing attention solely on the firearm. At the bottom right, there are small, faintly inscribed letters.
title: Muzzle Loading Pistol
